rule: A family is one sprite set plus one AI tag, with four tier rows. The tier is an integer 0 to 3 (the intelligence column). Each AI formula reads that one integer: the kin call radius is 2t+4 tiles, the kin call heal is 2t+2 hit points, the kin call timer is 30t+105 ticks, and the call roll is one in four. The hider fades out at distance 6-t or more and in below 5-t, with a one-tile dead band; its adjacent strike chance is 4t+10 percent. The sway-and-lunge creature sways on a roll at or above 35-2t and lunges at exactly two tiles on a clear line. Spawn slots per level are walkable tiles in the 80 by 80 core divided by 30, +50 percent in multiplayer; groups are 1 on depth 1 or on a coin flip, 2-3 on depth 2 and crypt, 3-5 otherwise. Defects: two of 24 four-row families break the 0-1-2-3 tier ladder (spear family 0,2,2,3; black knight family 0,0,1,1).
keep: One tier integer drives several AI formulas, so one family body and one tier ladder give many creatures.
Kin call with radius, heal and timer that grow per tier, behind a one-in-four roll on the last stand frame.
Fade hider with a one-tile dead band between fade-in and fade-out distances.
Two-tile lunge trigger with a clear-line test and a reused charge missile.
Spawn density set by walkable area divided by a constant.
change: Move every constant (call chance, radius, timer, heal, strike percent, sway roll) into family data, not code.
Renumber the spear and black knight families to 0-3 and add a load-time check of one row per tier.
Write the sway percent as a named field; the code reads as 65+2t percent and the intent is not stated.
Server-side seeded rolls; the engine emits call, fade and lunge events and the client draws them.
Add a visible rear-up telegraph before the lunge; the call shows a ring.
Cap attackers at three per Frankendom rulings (MAX_ATTACKERS = 3); the rest wait on the hate list.
look_test: Target file src/fight/ai-tier.ts (new), parity row 2 (AI brain). Build one four-tier family from one sprite set with four palette swaps; give tier 3 a call ring of radius 2t+4 tiles. On a phone at 375 wide compare the four tiers side by side (does the tier read at a glance?) and one tier-3 call with and without the ring (does the escalation read?). If the tier does not read, add a size step, not a new sprite.
